description: Move an already-placed object to a new tile/level/rotation on the same lot. Same command handles pure rotation (pass the object's current x/y with a new dir). Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side VMTSOLotState.OwnerID gate) OR (for own-owned decor) VMTSOObjectState.OwnerID == you. Object must be present at target_object_id in the lot VM and must be user-movable (e.g. a Sim cannot be moved with this). Effect: the object's position/rotation updates in nearby_objects. Cost: none. Wire: VMNetMoveObjectCmd on the lot Aries socket.
